text: In simulated diagonal linear networks for underdetermined sparse recovery ($d=40$, $n=100$, ground-truth $||x^*||_{L_0}=5$), the proposed PILoT initialization (constant per-coordinate scale $2u_{0,i}v_{0,i}=1$) together with a strongly decaying $\alpha_t$ schedule recovers the ground-truth $x^*$ faster and more accurately (smaller $||x_t-x^*||_{L_2}$ trajectories) than the baselines of spred initialization, $L_1$ on $m$ only, and standard $L_1$ on $x$.
